messages:
liam.h: quick flag from the mistralx onboarding: int4 conversion shows embed projection ordering differences vs fp16 that only appear when using alternating head packing (pack=alt). outputs are fine for short prompts but diverge on long-context QA.

nina.z: can you share a minimal repro and the conversion flags? sounds like proj matrix row/col transpose mismatch.

liam.h: repro attached in phab T13077. command: 
```
python -m rwinf.eval \\
  --model mistralx-13b-int4 \\
  --pack-mode alt \\
  --prompt tests/qa/long_prompts.txt \\
  --pad-to 2048
```

carlos.v: did you also try pack=contig? that toggles how we interleave proj matrices into lanes.

liam.h: pack=contig matches fp16. pack=alt flips token-level top-1 for ~12% of samples. small token diff: fp16->"Berlin" vs int4-alt->"Berlink" (nonsense).

nina.z: please paste the proj weight hex of the offending token id before/after conversion. could be an endian + stride bug in our pack_alt kernel.

liam.h: small excerpt: 
```
embed[5234] fp16 (dump): 0x3f8c1a...
proj_row0 int4 (alt-packed): 0x1a2b3c... (looks shifted)
```

carlos.v: that aligns with a packing index math issue i patched last month for gemma. alt packing uses a tile width of 16 but we assumed row-major vs column-major in conversion. i'll try a quick fix.

nina.z: also add a conversion-time checksum that reconstructs a slice of proj for a few token ids and compares to fp16 reference (tolerance). will catch this class of errors early.

liam.h: created phab T13077 with repro and added a tiny runner that compares first 64 dims of embed->proj for first 100 token ids.

ci-bot: build queued for branch fix/mistralx-altpack-index (job 10450). :gear:

carlos.v: patched conversion logic: swap tile transpose for alt pack and added checksum. local run shows pack=alt now matches fp16 on the smoke set. pushing PR.

liam.h: thanks. once CI passes can you run 1k prompt sweep and add a quick rouge/EM table in the phab ticket? want to ensure no subtle regression in generation quality.

nina.z: i bumped the conversion README: note about pack-mode and checksum, and added a bullet to onboarding checklist: "validate embed->proj slice equality for several token ids across pack modes".

liam.h: PR link: https://internal/redwood/pull/4978. i'll run the sweep after merge and post results. leaving thread for records. :eyes:
